summary: Iteration 233 - Batch 21 (Brand Portal / Chain HQ + White-Label) tested. Backend: 22/22 passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. Brand Portal panel shows consolidated KPIs across 10 properties, alerts for unanswered reviews and low occupancy, and per-property white-label branding with live preview.

issues: Console warning about color input format when values are empty (cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality)

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/brand-portal/branding/{property_id} auto-seeds defaults (primary_color=#0f172a, secondary_color=#f59e0b) on first call
PUT /api/brand-portal/branding/{property_id} updates branding and returns {updated: true}
GET /api/brand-portal/public-branding/{property_id} works WITHOUT auth and strips from_email from response
GET /api/brand-portal/overview?days=30 returns total KPIs, properties[], by_revenue[] (sorted desc), by_occupancy[], lowest_rating[]
GET /api/brand-portal/alerts?days=7 returns alerts[] with type (unread_inbox|unanswered_reviews|low_occupancy), severity (warn|info)
Frontend uses indigo color theme for Brand Portal panel
Live preview card shows primary_color as background and secondary_color for CTA button
